hypothesis: A preregistered Phase-5 G1 matched-oracle adjudication can compare the minimum clearable lane-aligned OBB distance of grip, required controlled-slide, and free arms on planar and Chrono plants, using the physical first-contact plane and controlled-slide constraints, before any universal theorem, real-vehicle, promotion, or self-ID claim.

parent_objective: adjudicate whether deliberate controlled slide enlarges the bounded pre-slip static-obstacle feasible set
bridge the force-envelope inclusion theorem to matched detailed-model evidence without conservative-control clipping
derived_from: M3265 proved positive-control sensitivity but blocked on mode expressibility
M3266 proved same-plant slide entry and priced a 0.50 s Chrono onset scale
M3266 review requires OBB first-contact timing, stable slide constraints, and matched grip/slide/free oracles
blocked_by: M3267 corrected quick failed planar all-arm completeness, so its full run is blocked
post-slip strict-recovery and paper claim updates require a separately preregistered healthy pre-slip verdict
supersedes: constant-command maximum-displacement sweeps as the load-bearing pre-slip comparison
obstacle-center timing as a proxy for pre-contact slide onset
two-arm comparisons without an unconstrained free-oracle search-health check
invalidates: giving required-slide extra actuator or yaw-rate authority
counting late slide onset after the OBB near face as valid
generalizing the finite-domain result to split-mu, moving obstacles, terminal yaw, real vehicles, or slide-only direct yaw moment

public_gates: write preregistration before quick and full execution
run quick before the managed full run
retain M3265's known larger-control-set positive control and M3266's same-plant slide-entry positive controls
use the same plant, actuator limits, physical action mapping, optimizer budget, and distance range within each backend
require grip beta<=0.12 and controlled slide beta in [0.20,0.60] for four frames before the true OBB contact plane
reject beta>0.70, speed<4 m/s, collision, road departure, or incomplete pass in every arm
produce finite D-star for grip, required-slide, and free in every cell
require free D-star no worse than the better constrained arm by more than 0.25 m
support no-drift advantage only when grip D-star <= slide D-star +0.25 m in every planar and Chrono cell
falsify on any valid slide or early-slide free arm that beats grip by more than 0.25 m
keep the result finite-domain and leave the incumbent unchanged
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change thresholds, distance tolerance, geometry, cells, or budgets after reading quick/full results
do not compare a mode-invalid slide search against a valid grip search
do not omit the free arm or ignore free-search inconsistency
do not count obstacle-center onset instead of vehicle-front versus obstacle-near-face contact
do not call uniform braking production ESC
do not train a policy or mutate ActiveSafetyReflexDriver
do not claim split-mu, moving-obstacle, terminal-pose, arbitrary-vehicle, real-car, promotion, or self-ID coverage

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: minimum-clearable-distance boundaries for matched grip, required controlled-slide, and free oracles on planar and Chrono plants
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: finite lane-aligned static-OBB detailed-model adjudication supporting, falsifying, or leaving inconclusive the bounded theorem bridge
stop_condition: stop as inconclusive if any arm lacks a finite D-star or the free consistency gate fails
stop as falsified if any valid slide/free controlled-slide counterexample clears more than 0.25 m closer than grip
stop as bounded support only if every planar and Chrono cell passes every frozen gate
stop after raw rows, review, scoreboard, and ledger state are written
fallback_plan: if quick arm completeness fails, block full and re-price without reading dominance
if full free consistency fails, report optimizer underpowering rather than a physical conclusion
if a counterexample appears, preserve its actions and trajectory for independent replay
if bounded support appears, run a separately registered post-slip strict-recovery panel before editing the paper claim
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M3265 and M3266 completed the positive-control and mode-entry pricing needed for final pre-slip adjudication

training_stage.stage_objective: Search and compare matched constrained and free control trajectories without policy training.
admission_evidence: M3265 known larger-control-set witness, search health, determinism, and telemetry passed
M3266 same-plant planar and Chrono beta=0 slide entry passed with exact Chrono replay
the bounded theory certificate states assumptions and forbidden universal extensions
blocked_shortcuts: no universal theorem or self-ID claim
next_stage_criteria: a Chrono-only full adjudication may be registered from M3267's healthy corrected Chrono quick pricing with fresh cells and seed streams
post-slip strict-recovery adjudication is registered only after a healthy pre-slip verdict
paper claim text changes only after both pre-slip and post-slip evidence packages are complete
any broader geometry, road, vehicle, or actuator claim requires separate pricing and preregistration

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M3267 evaluates deterministic per-instance open-loop reachability oracles and makes no history attribution claim.
history_necessity_tests: none; no learned history policy is evaluated
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: finite open-loop action trajectories with explicit body and tire truth
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Counterexamples, missing arms, free inconsistency, and mode-invalid searches are reported at full fidelity and cannot be converted into bounded support.

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds matched minimum-clearable-distance boundaries, true OBB contact timing, controlled-slide stability constraints, and a free-oracle consistency check across two dynamics backends
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: A valid M3267 result can change only the bounded pre-slip mechanism claim; post-slip and final paper readiness remain separate.
must_synthesize_if: any optimizer-only repair is proposed after a free-consistency failure
cells or tolerance are proposed to change after result inspection
a counterexample is dismissed without exact action replay
finite-domain support is proposed as a universal theorem

success_criteria: preregistration exists before quick and full execution
quick artifact exists and passes all health gates before full
every full planar and Chrono cell has finite grip, required-slide, and free D-star
free consistency passes in every cell
the decision is exactly bounded_empirical_support, counterexample_found, or inconclusive by the frozen rule
all best actions, refined boundaries, arm rows, and cell verdicts are persisted
the result changes no incumbent and makes no self-ID claim
failure_criteria: full runs before preregistration or quick
any arm-completeness or free-consistency gate is hidden
a late, unstable, stopped, off-road, or mode-invalid slide is counted as success
thresholds, budgets, cells, geometry, or tolerance change after result inspection
the finite-domain result is generalized to an excluded scope
decision_rule: Return bounded_empirical_support only when all positive controls, arm-completeness, free-consistency, and no-drift-advantage gates pass in every frozen planar and Chrono cell. Return counterexample_found when a valid required-slide or early-slide free arm clears more than 0.25 m closer than grip under healthy searches. Otherwise return inconclusive.
